name: Royal Malewane
positioning: All-inclusive safari collection of four lodges and three private villas in the Greater Kruger National Park, unfenced from the Kruger National Park
best_for: Travelers wanting an all-inclusive Big Five safari with game drives and guided walks
Families or groups wanting an exclusive-use private villa

facts.text: Royal Malewane is located within the Greater Kruger National Park in South Africa.
Royal Malewane is in the Thornybush Private Nature Reserve.
Royal Malewane has four lodges: Malewane Lodge, The Farmstead, Waterside and Masiya's Camp.
Malewane Lodge has a classic layout and an elegant interior style with dark woods, and vast raised decks overlooking the African bushveld.
Masiya's Camp is a tented camp named after the tracker Wilson Masiya.
Africa House is the original Biden family homestead, reinvented as a safari villa.
The Reflections Spa at Waterside has a Hammam.
Guests can go on twice daily game drives.
Guided walks through the Greater Kruger National Park are offered.
Guests can visit the Conservation & Research Centre at Royal Malewane.
Rates are all-inclusive: meals, game drives, soft drinks, house wines, local beverages and the in-room mini-bar are included, excluding premium beverages.
Liz and Phil Biden opened Royal Malewane in the Greater Kruger National Park in 1999.

highlights.text: No fences separate Royal Malewane's reserve from the Kruger National Park, and wildlife roams freely across the protected area.
Royal Malewane is also home to three exclusive-use private villas: Africa House, Waterside House and Farmhouse.
The Royal Waters Spa at Malewane Lodge has a fitness centre, sauna, cold plunge, outdoor baths and a hair salon.
Each of the main dining areas at Royal Malewane overlooks a different waterhole.
Waterside is vast and spacious, with playful colour that reflects the brighter details of the bush.

considerations.text: Children over 10 are welcome in the Luxury Suites at Malewane Lodge, the Luxury Farm Suites at Farmstead and the Luxury Tented Suites at Masiya's Camp; Waterside welcomes children of all ages.
Royal Malewane is in a low-risk malaria area.
Hoedspruit's Eastgate Airport is the closest airport, a 45-minute drive from the lodges.
